newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon unit wins Spartan Steel contract.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon unit wins Spartan Steel contract.

text.p: Raytheon Engineers & Constructors, a unit of Raytheon Co, said Monday it had received a contract from Spartan Steel, a steel-galvanizing joint venture between Worthington Industries Inc and Rouge Steel Co.
The contract is to provide engineering, selected procurement and construction services for a steel-galvanizing plant in Monroe, Michigan, the company said.
Terms of the pact were not disclosed
The facility will have the capacity to produce about 450,000 tons per year of cold-rolled, hot-dip galvanized steel, the company said.
It said that project engineering is under way and the facility's start-up is scheduled for the first half of 1998.
